info.title: RelayHub HTTP API
info.description: Shipped MVP routes. JSON bodies are limited to 1 MiB; unknown top-level request fields fail. IDs are opaque. HTTPS production origin. No tenant API or SDK package is shipped. Operations endpoints also run on the worker private listener. Standard errors use {error:{code,message}}; unknown routes use 404 not_found and unsupported methods 405 method_not_allowed. HTTP signature details: /docs/developer/auth.md.

post.summary: Persist an event and one job per target
post.description: Atomic persistence precedes notifications. Target IDs are trimmed, unique, sorted, enabled apps. Type is trimmed and data is an object. Replays return original event and initial job snapshots, including when payload changes; inspect job GET for current state. All targets get durable queue work regardless of delivery mode.

post.summary: Invoke an application-owned handler over WebSocket
post.description: Any authenticated app knowing an enabled function ID may invoke it. Input is an object; the entire rpc.invoke frame must fit 64 KiB. Only one owner session can claim the invocation (250 ms window). No offline queue or automatic redispatch. Handler ok:false remains HTTP 200. Results and unavailable/timeout outcomes persist for caller/key replay for 24 hours. Same key ignores a changed function/input. Idempotency-Key is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key per logical action, scoped to authenticated producer/caller. Events use configured retention (24h default); functions always 24h. Reusing a key returns the original result even when the submitted content changes. Never put credentials in keys. Maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes.

get.description: URL query token requires ws:connect. Valid token with missing scope or disallowed Origin receives 403. Absent/empty Origin is allowed; otherwise exact configured match. Token expiry is checked at handshake only. Socket.IO is unsupported. Then exchange /docs/schemas/client-frame.schema.json and server-frame.schema.json frames. Heartbeat, message bounds and reconnect recovery are in /docs/developer/websocket.md.

get.description: Catch-all GET /docs/* includes /docs/ (index.html), Markdown, JSON, CSS, JS, text and Skill ZIP. Paths may contain subdirectories; existing directories redirect to trailing slash, and index.html redirects to ./ using 301. Unknown assets return JSON 404. Conditional requests may return 304 and ranges 206 or 416. No runtime Node/server dependency.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Relative embedded asset path, including slash-separated subdirectories. The HTTP router serves a catch-all under /docs/.

schema.description: Embedded OpenAPI documents, JSON Schemas and other JSON metadata are JSON objects.

Credentials.description: One-time credentials. Keep only in an approved secret store; never log or expose to browsers. Rotation invalidates both prior values.

name.description: Leading/trailing Unicode whitespace is trimmed with Go strings.TrimSpace. The trimmed value must be nonempty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. This pattern enforces nonempty and a 128-character upper bound after trimming; the runtime additionally enforces the stricter UTF-8 byte limit (for example, 65 é characters exceed it).

callback_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL with a host, no userinfo and no fragment. HTTPS is allowed by default, including private destinations. HTTP requires RELAYHUB_ALLOW_INSECURE_CALLBACKS=true and a host recognized by the runtime as localhost, a .localhost/.local/.internal suffix (case-insensitive, one final dot removed), or an IP satisfying Go IsLoopback, IsPrivate or IsLinkLocalUnicast. No DNS lookup is performed for this classification.

CreateApp.description: App validation runs after trimming the name. callback/all require a non-null callback_url. queue/websocket allow null. A non-null URL must also satisfy the runtime HTTPS/local-HTTP policy.

name.description: Leading/trailing Unicode whitespace is trimmed with Go strings.TrimSpace. The trimmed value must be nonempty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. This pattern enforces nonempty and a 128-character upper bound after trimming; the runtime additionally enforces the stricter UTF-8 byte limit (for example, 65 é characters exceed it).

callback_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL with a host, no userinfo and no fragment. HTTPS is allowed by default, including private destinations. HTTP requires RELAYHUB_ALLOW_INSECURE_CALLBACKS=true and a host recognized by the runtime as localhost, a .localhost/.local/.internal suffix (case-insensitive, one final dot removed), or an IP satisfying Go IsLoopback, IsPrivate or IsLinkLocalUnicast. No DNS lookup is performed for this classification.

UpdateApp.description: App validation runs after trimming the name. callback/all require a non-null callback_url. queue/websocket allow null. PATCH is applied to persisted state first: changing to callback/all without a URL is valid only if the existing app already has a valid URL; clearing callback_url is valid only when the resulting mode is queue/websocket. Send delivery_mode and callback_url together when changing both.

error.description: Message limit is 1024 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength is a character bound. The runtime enforces the byte bound.

AppApiKey.name: X-RelayHub-Api-Key
AppApiKey.description: Application API key; must accompany timestamp and signature.

AppSignature.name: X-RelayHub-Signature
AppSignature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + LF + method + LF + exact request target (path and query) + LF + lowercase SHA256 of exact body bytes. No trailing LF. Use the UTF-8 bytes of the entire issued HMAC secret; do not decode its prefix or suffix. See /docs/developer/auth.md.

SocketToken.name: token
SocketToken.description: Short-lived server-issued token with ws:connect scope. URL-encode it; omit query strings from logs.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key per logical action, scoped to authenticated producer/caller. Events use configured retention (24h default); functions always 24h. Reusing a key returns the original result even when the submitted content changes. Never put credentials in keys.

Timestamp.name: X-RelayHub-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Unix seconds, decimal text. Default permitted skew is ±300 seconds. Sign this exact text.

Signature.name: X-RelayHub-Signature
Signature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + LF + method + LF + exact request target (path and query) + LF + lowercase SHA256 of exact body bytes. No trailing LF. Use the UTF-8 bytes of the entire issued HMAC secret; do not decode its prefix or suffix. See /docs/developer/auth.md.
